title: Validate successful LTE single UE attach and detach under excellent radio conditions
description: Verify that a single UE can successfully attach and detach to/from an LTE cell 10 consecutive times under excellent radio conditions with 100% success rate.
preconditions: Single LTE cell is active and all other cells are powered off
UE is stationary and placed at cell center with LTE RSRP as per Clause 4.6 (excellent radio conditions)
Test environment (lab or field) is set up with no inter-cell interference
testSteps: Configure the test setup with specified test configuration parameters and record them
Activate the serving LTE cell under test
Place the UE under excellent LTE radio conditions (LTE RSRP defined in Clause 4.6)
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure
Wait for successful attach confirmation by validating attach request and attach complete messages
Measure and record attach latency from attach request to attach complete
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach procedure
Wait for successful detach confirmation by validating detach request and detach accept messages
Stop and save logs for the iteration
Repeat steps 4 to 10 for a total of 10 iterations
Calculate and record attach success rate, detach success rate, and latency metrics (min, average, max) in test report tables 5-2 and 5-3
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures complete successfully 10 consecutive times with 100% success rate
Attach latency values captured and sorted as per requirements
UE is attached to correct cell, validated by PCI, Global eNB ID, and ARFCN
Signaling connection release validated by UE context release and RRC connection release messages
Test logs saved for reference and analysis
postconditions: Test report contains recorded KPIs and radio parameters
verificationMethods: Analyze captured logs for attach/detach message flows

title: Validate successful 5G NSA single UE attach and detach under excellent radio conditions
description: Verify that a single UE can successfully attach and detach to/from a 5G NSA cell 10 consecutive times under excellent radio conditions with 100% success rate, including secondary node addition and release.
preconditions: Single 5G NSA cell is active and all other cells are powered off
UE is stationary and placed at cell center with 5G SS-RSRP as per Clause 4.6 (excellent radio conditions)
Test environment (lab or field) is set up with no inter-cell interference
testSteps: Configure the test setup with specified test configuration parameters and record them
Activate the serving 5G NSA cell under test
Place the UE under excellent 5G NSA radio conditions (5G SS-RSRP defined in Clause 4.6)
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure
Wait for successful attach confirmation by validating attach request and attach complete messages
Validate secondary node addition by confirming SgNB addition request and SgNB reconfiguration complete messages
Measure and record attach success rate and secondary node addition success rate
Power OFF the UE to initiate 5G NSA detach procedure
Wait for successful detach confirmation by validating detach request and detach accept messages, including secondary node release
Stop and save logs for the iteration
Repeat steps 4 to 11 for a total of 10 iterations
Calculate and record attach success rate, detach success rate, and secondary node addition success rate in test report tables 5-2
expectedResults: Attach, secondary node addition, and detach procedures complete successfully 10 consecutive times with 100% success rate
UE is attached to correct LTE and 5G cells, validated by PCI, Global eNB/gNB ID, and ARFCN/NR-ARFCN
Signaling connection release validated by UE context release and RRC connection release messages, including 5G secondary node release
Test logs saved for reference and analysis
postconditions: UE detached from 5G NSA cell and secondary node released
Test report contains recorded KPIs and radio parameters
verificationMethods: Analyze captured logs for attach, secondary node addition, and detach message flows

title: Negative test: UE attach failure due to poor radio conditions
description: Verify that the UE fails to attach to LTE or 5G NSA cell when radio conditions are below minimum coupling loss or poor RSRP/SS-RSRP levels.
preconditions: Single cell active with reduced radio quality (RSRP/SS-RSRP below threshold defined in Clause 4.6)
UE is stationary and placed under poor radio conditions
testSteps: Configure the test setup with poor radio conditions using attenuator/fading generator or emulator
Activate the serving cell under test
Place the UE under poor radio conditions
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate attach procedure
Wait for attach procedure to timeout or fail
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails or times out as UE is unable to establish connection under poor radio conditions
No successful attach or secondary node addition messages received
Attach success rate is 0%
Logs show error or failure messages related to attach
postconditions: Test report documents failure and KPIs accordingly
commandsUsed: Radio condition adjustment using attenuator/fading generator or emulator
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach failure or timeout
Confirm no attach complete messages are present

title: Negative test: UE detach failure or timeout
description: Verify the system behavior when UE detach procedure fails or times out after successful attach.
preconditions: Single cell active with excellent radio conditions
UE attached successfully
testSteps: Power ON the UE and complete successful attach
Simulate network or UE failure causing detach request or accept messages to be lost or delayed
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach
Wait for detach procedure to timeout or fail
Capture logs during failure
Attempt recovery or re-attach
expectedResults: Detach procedure fails or times out
Signaling connection release messages are not received or incomplete
Detach success rate is less than 100%
Recovery mechanisms trigger to restore connectivity or retry detach
Logs reflect failure scenario
postconditions: UE may remain connected or in undefined state
Test report documents failure and recovery steps
commandsUsed: Network simulation for message loss or delay
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for missing detach messages

title: Edge case: Attach and detach procedures with fluctuating radio conditions
description: Test attach and detach success rates when radio conditions vary around the threshold of excellent conditions during attach and detach iterations.
preconditions: Single cell active
UE placed with radio conditions fluctuating near minimum coupling loss and RSRP/SS-RSRP threshold
testSteps: Configure radio conditions to oscillate between excellent and marginal levels during attach-detach iterations
Perform 10 attach and detach cycles
Capture KPIs and logs for each iteration
Analyze attach success rate, detach success rate, and latency variations
expectedResults: Some attach or detach attempts may fail or exhibit increased latency
KPIs reflect impact of fluctuating radio conditions
Attach/detach success rate may be below 100%
Logs show variations in signaling message timings
postconditions: Test report includes gap analysis between measured and expected KPIs
verificationMethods: Analyze KPIs for trends related to radio condition changes
Review logs for message timing variances

title: Performance test: Measure attach and detach latency under load
description: Evaluate attach and detach latency and success rates when multiple attach-detach sequences are performed sequentially on a single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell active under excellent radio conditions
UE stationary and ready for multiple iterations
testSteps: Perform 10 consecutive attach and detach cycles with minimal delay between iterations
Capture attach request to attach complete latency for each iteration
Capture detach request to detach accept latency for each iteration
Record KPIs in test report
Analyze min, average, max latency values
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rate is 100%
Latency values within acceptable limits as per specification
No degradation in latency over iterations
postconditions: KPIs recorded and analyzed for performance bottlenecks
verificationMethods: Review latency KPIs and logs for performance consistency

title: Security test: Validate authentication during attach procedure
description: Verify that UE authentication takes place successfully during LTE and 5G NSA attach procedures under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell active
UE capable of authentication procedures
testSteps: Power ON the UE to initiate attach
Capture authentication messages within attach procedure logs
Validate presence and correctness of authentication request and response messages
Ensure successful attach only occurs after successful authentication
expectedResults: Authentication messages are exchanged correctly
Attach procedure completes only after successful authentication
No unauthorized attach allowed
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for authentication message flow

title: Integration test: Validate coordination between MN and SN during 5G NSA secondary node release
description: Verify that the Master Node (MN) and Secondary Node (SN) properly execute the Secondary Node Release procedure as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1, including message exchanges and resource releases.
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with active MN and SN
UE attached with active secondary node
testSteps: Initiate MN initiated SN Release by sending SgNB Release Request from MN to SN
Validate SN response with SgNB Release Request Acknowledge
Validate RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE to release SCG configuration
Confirm SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages to MN
Verify UE Context Release message sent to SN
Verify SN releases radio and C-plane resources
Repeat procedure for SN initiated SN Release starting with SgNB Release Required message from SN
Capture and analyze message flows for correctness
expectedResults: All messages exchanged correctly between MN and SN as per signaling flow
UE receives RRCConnectionReconfiguration to release SCG
SN releases resources upon UE Context Release
Data forwarding coordinated timely between MN and SN
No signaling failures or inconsistencies
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for message sequence and content

title: Usability test: Verify clarity and completeness of test configuration recording
description: Ensure that the test configuration parameters used in the attach-detach tests are clearly recorded and understandable in the test report.
preconditions: Test configuration parameters set before test execution
testSteps: Perform attach-detach test as per standard procedure
Record all utilized test configuration parameters in test report
Review test report for clarity, completeness, and correctness of recorded parameters
Verify that parameters include PCI, Global eNB/gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN, radio conditions, and any other relevant settings
expectedResults: Test configuration parameters are fully and clearly documented
Report enables reproducibility of the test setup
No ambiguous or missing configuration details
postconditions: Test report finalized with complete configuration details
verificationMethods: Manual review of test report content

title: Compatibility test: Validate attach-detach procedure across different UE emulators and real UE devices
description: Verify that the attach-detach procedure succeeds with both real and emulated UEs under identical test conditions.
preconditions: Test environment supports both real UE and UE emulator
Single cell active under excellent radio conditions
testSteps: Perform attach-detach test with a real UE following the standard procedure
Record KPIs and logs
Perform attach-detach test with a UE emulator using the same configuration and setup
Record KPIs and logs
Compare results between real UE and emulator
Check for any discrepancies or failures
expectedResults: Both real UE and UE emulator achieve 100% attach and detach success rate
KPIs such as latency and success rates are comparable within acceptable variance
No unique failures observed on either platform
commandsUsed: Generic UE power ON/OFF actions for real and emulated UE
verificationMethods: Compare KPI tables and logs for both UE types
